entry.title: welcome
entry.content:
This page collects notes and longer pieces on scientific machine learning, numerical analysis for PDEs and dynamical systems, and related research topics. Posts can include mathematics, for example the Fredholm integral equation of the second kind

\[f(x) = g(x) + \int_{\Omega} K(x, z)\, f(z)\, dz ,\]

as well as code and figures.
